registry_snapshot.name: USES_OUTPUT_OF_PRIOR_ACTION
registry_snapshot.definition: A subsequent agent action consumes, as an input argument or dependency, an artifact or output that was generated by an earlier agent action.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An earlier agent action that generated an artifact, file, or value.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent agent action that references or consumes that generated artifact as input.

registry_snapshot.name: VERIFIES_OUTPUT_OF_PRIOR_ACTION
registry_snapshot.definition: A subsequent agent action is executed in order to test or validate the correctness of an artifact produced by an earlier agent action.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An earlier agent action that produced an artifact whose correctness must be validated.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent agent action intended to verify or validate the correctness of that artifact.

registry_snapshot.name: CORROBORATES_PRIOR_OBSERVATION
registry_snapshot.definition: A later execution observation reports a condition that is consistent with and confirms a condition already reported by an earlier observation.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An earlier observation reporting a missing resource or environmental condition.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A later observation reporting a consistent condition or consequent failure that confirms the earlier observation.

registry_snapshot.name: ATTEMPTS_TO_REPAIR_FAILURE
registry_snapshot.definition: A subsequent agent action attempts to resolve a failure or missing prerequisite that was identified during an earlier execution step.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An earlier observed execution failure, such as a required command, dependency, or resource being unavailable.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent agent action intended to resolve that failure by establishing the missing prerequisite.

registry_snapshot.name: USES_DIAGNOSTIC_OBSERVATION_TO_SELECT_ACTION
registry_snapshot.definition: A diagnostic observation about the execution environment or system state is used to determine which subsequent command or action is appropriate.
registry_snapshot.source_description: A diagnostic observation about the execution environment or system state.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequently selected action chosen based on that diagnostic observation.

registry_snapshot.name: DECLARES_COMPLETION_BASED_ON_VERIFIED_RESULTS
registry_snapshot.definition: A final completion decision is asserted and grounded in previously verified successful execution results and validated output artifacts.
registry_snapshot.source_description: A set of previously verified successful results and validated output artifacts.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent agent declaration that the task is complete and ready for grading.

registry_snapshot.name: INVESTIGATES_FAILURE_CAUSE
registry_snapshot.definition: An execution failure whose cause is not yet understood is followed by a diagnostic action that inspects environment or tool state (e.g., versions, logs, installed packages) in order to explain the failure before attempting a repair.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An earlier observed execution failure whose cause is not yet understood.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent diagnostic action that inspects environment or tool state to determine the cause of the failure.

registry_snapshot.name: VERIFIES_DEPENDENCY_AVAILABILITY_BEFORE_USE
registry_snapshot.definition: An agent decision to rely on a particular library, package, or tool is followed by an explicit check that the dependency is actually installed and available in the environment before it is used.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An agent decision to use a particular library, package, or tool as part of the plan.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent query that confirms whether that dependency is present in the environment.

registry_snapshot.name: MONITORS_ASYNC_LONG_RUNNING_OPERATION
registry_snapshot.definition: An action that launches a long-running or background operation (such as a package build or installation) is followed by a separate action that waits for and inspects the progress or completion status of that operation.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An agent action that starts a long-running or background operation.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent action that polls or inspects the status or output of that operation.

registry_snapshot.name: ENABLES_SUBSEQUENT_TOOL_USE
registry_snapshot.definition: A subsequent agent action relies on a tool, library, or capability that became available as the result of an earlier successful setup, installation, or environment-preparation step.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An earlier execution observation confirming that a required tool, library, or capability has been successfully installed or otherwise made available.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent agent action that invokes or relies on that now-available tool, library, or capability.

registry_snapshot.name: INVESTIGATES_INCONSISTENCY_FROM_RESULT
registry_snapshot.definition: A subsequent diagnostic or investigative action is performed in response to an earlier execution result that reveals conflicting, ambiguous, or inconsistent evidence, in order to resolve the inconsistency.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An earlier execution result or observation that reveals conflicting, ambiguous, or inconsistent evidence.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent diagnostic or investigative action intended to resolve that inconsistency.

registry_snapshot.name: SELECTS_CANDIDATE_FROM_EVALUATION
registry_snapshot.definition: A subsequent agent decision or action adopts one among multiple candidate alternatives based on the outcome of an earlier evaluation, scoring, or comparison of those alternatives.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An earlier execution result that evaluates, scores, or compares candidate alternatives.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent agent decision or action that adopts the selected alternative.

accepted_edge_types.name: IDENTIFIES_TRANSFORMATION_WEAKNESS_FROM_OBSERVATION
accepted_edge_types.definition: An agent recognizes a specific weakness, limitation, or discrepancy in the behavior of a target transformation or processing mechanism by observing its implementation or execution, enabling subsequent construction of content that exploits it.
accepted_edge_types.source_description: An observation of the target transformation's implementation or execution behavior that reveals how it processes content.
accepted_edge_types.target_description: The agent's conclusion identifying a specific exploitable weakness or discrepancy in that transformation.

accepted_edge_types.name: DESIGNS_CANDIDATE_TO_EVADE_TRANSFORMATION
accepted_edge_types.definition: An agent creates a candidate artifact that is deliberately constructed, based on previously observed transformation logic, so that it survives or bypasses the target transformation.
accepted_edge_types.source_description: An earlier observation of the target transformation's logic or of its effect on content.
accepted_edge_types.target_description: A subsequent agent action that creates a candidate artifact intended to bypass the transformation.

accepted_edge_types.name: DERIVES_SUCCESS_CRITERIA_FROM_VERIFICATION_SCRIPT
accepted_edge_types.definition: An agent inspects a test or verification script to determine the conditions under which the task will be judged successful, and uses that understanding to guide subsequent solution construction.
accepted_edge_types.source_description: An observation of a verification or test script that defines how the solution will be evaluated.
accepted_edge_types.target_description: A subsequent agent action or solution strategy aimed at satisfying the identified success criteria.
